title: 10 Quiet Things a Godly Man Does Before 8 AM
caption:
Nothing on this list will go viral. That's the point. A man gets built in the quiet hours before anyone is watching.

Pick three. Do them for a week. Save this for tomorrow morning.

Which one are you skipping?

#faith #discipline #morningroutine #godlymen #christianman
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
